subject: CAIQ evidence request — tenant-scoped isolation & log samples
messages:
From: Priya Suresh <priya@orbitcloud.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@orbitcloud.com
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ evidence request: tenant-scoped runtime isolation + log samples

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As part of OrbitCloud's CSA/CAIQ ingestion we need a compact set of artifacts showing how Redwood enforces tenant-scoped runtime isolation and a short sample of operational logs for retention/alerting verification. Specifically we are asking for:

- A mapping that ties CAIQ control IDs to Redwood documentation (high priority: CCM controls related to tenancy/isolation and logging; e.g., boundary isolation, encryption-at-rest/in-flight, and telemetry).
- A redacted log sample that demonstrates a 30-day retention/rotation for request/response traces (redact tokens/user PII).
- Diagram or sequence showing K/V cache and KV-prefix isolation across tenants (e.g., how prefixing/KV cache prevents cross-tenant leakage).
- A short attestation or summary of KMS key rotation policy and where tenant keys (or per-tenant envelopes) are used.

We are running a compressed audit window and would like the bundle by 2027-07-08 if possible. If you can provide the artifacts as a single secure bundle (or a Drive link with access control) that would be great. Happy to sign an NDA for any extra material but we prefer redacted samples to avoid extra paperwork.

Can you confirm owners and an ETA? Also please include any supporting notes on controls mapping (if you have a lightweight "annotated index" that maps each CAIQ question to the artifact and owner, that will speed review).

Thanks,
Priya Suresh
Security Program Manager
OrbitCloud

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Suresh <priya@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: security@orbitcloud.com
Date: 2027-06-25T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request: tenant-scoped runtime isolation + log samples

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can assemble a compact bundle that hits each of your bullets. High-level plan and owners below:

- Annotated CAIQ mapping (PDF): maps CAIQ question -> Redwood control name -> artifact pointer. Owner: myself (I'll draft and finalize).
- KV/cache isolation diagram (PNG): sequence + example config snippets showing prefixing/namespace enforcement. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Redacted log sample (gz): a 7-day extract representative of our retention policy with PII removed; includes retention header/traces. Owner: Marissa Cole (we'll redact at source).
- KMS rotation summary (PDF): rotation cadence, recent rotation proof, and whether per-tenant envelopes are used. Owner: Kimberly.

Target delivery: 2027-07-02 (two business days buffer before your 7/8 window). We'll provide a Drive share link with view-only access and a checksum. If we hit any items that require additional legal controls, we'll surface those immediately (but our intent is to deliver redacted artifacts only).

Propose a short sync on 2027-06-28 10:00 AM PT to walk the bundle and call out anything you need clarified — I can send a calendar invite if that works.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Marissa on the internal intake.

Best,
Soji n Lee
Security Programs — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-25T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: OrbitCloud CAIQ bundle (tenant isolation + logs) — owners & artifacts

Kimberly / Marissa —

Priya at OrbitCloud requested a compact CAIQ evidence bundle focused on tenant-scoped runtime isolation and log retention. Deliverable should be view-only in the Drive folder below and arrive by COB 2027-07-02. Please see tasks: 

Kimberly:
- Produce "kv-cache-isolation-diagram.png" (annotated sequence diagram + short caption). Include a short config snippet showing how namespace prefixing is applied and where kernel-level protections live (no raw code dumps).
- Draft KMS rotation note "kms-rotation-summary.pdf" that includes rotation cadence, key custodianship, and excerpt of rotation log (redact key material).

Marissa:
- Produce "log-sample-redacted.gz" — 3–7 day extract representative of request/response logs, with all tokens and PII redacted. Add accompanying README explaining redaction steps and retention metadata (timestamps, retention policy note).

Soji (me):

Redaction/Compliance notes: do not include any customer query text that contains private prompt/output; replace detected personal data with <<REDACTED>> and document the redaction script used. Marissa — please run the automated redactor and add a checksum for the output.

Drive folder (create under restricted access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_evidence-folder

Ping me with any blockers by EOD tomorrow. I will draft the external cover note and send once your artifacts land.

Thanks — Soojin
